facts.fact: The Interior ministry's principal secretary swore on 1 August 2024, as the High Court's ruling records it, that the identity data system supports government infrastructure including the police service's online occurrence book; the ruling gives no count of stations and does not say where entries are made.

systems.tiers: Not stated; named in an Interior ministry affidavit of 1 August 2024 as one of the government systems that depend on the national identity data system

note: A ruling on the Maisha identity card; the occurrence book appears once, in the ministry's list of systems that the stayed identity database supports, which is also a link from the police system to the national identity system.
